_comment: Everything the generated site needs to know that is not in the repo. storybookUrl is where components actually render — every page deep-links and embeds into it, so a wrong value produces a site full of dead links and blank frames rather than a build error. Check it opens before you ship. In development the frames need a Storybook that is not sending frame-ancestors: `npm run docs:dev` passes --storybook http://localhost:6006 for exactly that. If siteUrl and storybookUrl end up on different origins, the deployed frames stay blank until Storybook's CSP names this site — start/embedding says how.
title: Sunim Design System
description: What each component is for, when not to use it, and what the version number promises.
